# MRS OT Reliability — Cross-Team Follow-ups

**Author:** Denny Zhang (dennyzhang) · **Date:** 2026-05-27 · **Status:** Discussion draft

**Goal:** Make online training job recovery reliable — minutes, not hours. OT models need continuous uptime to maintain latency SLOs. Current infra (MAST, DPP, TMS, Publisher, SJD) was designed for batch tolerance (hours-to-days recovery). This doc catalogs gaps and proposes fixes, organized by the owning team.

## TL;DR

- **42 follow-ups(16 P0) across 7 components**, backed by 64 unique SEVs (Feb–May 2026).
- Worst incident: **S628346 — 974.6h SEV duration** (4 models idle 6–28h each).
- **Why So Many SEVs: **HoH is 4x (20 to 80): **1) More models**. Previously only 10ish models. In H1, IG +20 models, Video +20, Threads +10. **2) More strict SLAs**. NOT expect minutes SLA. But the training infra solution is mainly designed for hours. 3) **More usage patterns**. E.g: multicast 
- **Top categorical drivers:** 1) Publisher pipeline fragmentation (TGIF/GMPP/Conveyor — 28 SEV refs, no unified SLI, 15 still open); 2) MAST detection gaps for zombie containers / silent main-process exits (S628346 974h class); 3) CL-013 example-age recurrence from DPP session TTL (~280 dips/half — same root cause re-fires); 
- **Ongoing waste:** **~512 GPU-hr/month** from SJD coverage gaps; **15** publisher-related SEVs currently open.
